open_science_requirements: Communicable results must be shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform (CC-03, source: Scope, HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.slice.json).

Open access to research results is expected as per standard Horizon Europe RIA obligations, derived from confirmed RIA instrument type and explicit result-sharing mandate in Scope (EC-06, source: Scope, HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.slice.json).
